name: Oude Kaap Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
description: A smooth, approachable South African red blend featuring intense aromas of ripe cassis, dark plum, and red berries with soft tannins and a velvety finish.

name: Oude Kaap Elegant Wit
description: An elegant semi-sweet white wine highlighting soft aromas of tropical fruit, ripe melon, and sweet floral blossoms with a well-balanced refreshing acidity.

name: Oude Kaap Klassiek Wit
description: A crisp and fruity blend of Chenin Blanc and Colombard, boasting lively notes of green apple, guava, and vibrant citrus zest.

name: Oude Kaap Moscato
description: A delightfully sweet, light-bodied white wine with aromatic scents of orange blossom, fresh grape, honeyed peach, and a delicate spritz.

name: Oude Kaap Pinot Grigio
description: A dry, lively white wine with fragrant citrus aromas, juicy white peach, green pear, and a clean, mineral finish.

name: Oude Kaap Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
image: images/34172 DGB Oude kaap_Reserve Cab Sauv.png
description: A bold, full-bodied Reserve red wine matured in oak, showing rich layers of blackberry, cassis, cedarwood, and subtle vanilla spice.

name: Oude Kaap Reserve Chardonnay
description: A well-structured Reserve white offering expressive aromas of pineapple, ripe mango, citrus blossom, and creamy toasted oak complexity.

name: Oude Kaap Reserve Pinotage
description: South Africa's signature red grape crafted into a rich Reserve wine with ripe plum, dark chocolate, smoky spice, and smooth, refined tannins.

name: Oude Kaap Rosé
description: A charming salmon-pink rosé packed with juicy strawberry, fresh raspberry, and crisp watermelon notes, delivering a bright, crisp finish.
